memory_candidates: Computing path k-types of a finite labelled graph: keep ONE representative label list per (src, dst, flag, k-type) key in a Finset closure; the composition congruence on representatives makes the stored representative's recomputed type the type of every path with that key, and stationarity follows from a generic bounded-measure lemma (f^[B] is a fixpoint when a measure ≤ B strictly grows on each non-stationary step) applied to the key-image cardinality.

Never let an #eval touch Fintype.card (KType sig k) or iterate a closure for that many rounds: at depth 1 it is 2^256; compute the round bound arithmetically from Fintype.card (NormalForm sig k 0) and stop the computable iterate at the first stationary round, proving it equal to the Nat.iterate.

Liveness on a finite Boolean graph (does q start an infinite chain?) is cheapest as the greatest fixpoint of a pruning step: iterate 'keep states with a successor still in the set' card Q times; the fixpoint is successor-closed (build the chain with choose + Nat.rec) and any chain survives every round — no pigeonhole, no cycle unrolling.

Instance resolution does not synthesize DecidablePred for a conjunction under a binder (fun x => b = true ∧ x ∉ S) even though fun _ => instDecidableAnd typechecks; name the predicate and give it an instance so Finset.mem_filter resolves.
